summary: Appeal under Section 62 of the IBC challenging NCLAT's order refusing to stay the CIRP initiated by the financial creditor under Section 7; background concerns a generating project with multiple regulatory approvals and unresolved orders; issues involve applicability of IBC initiation and stay while related regulatory matters proceed; disposition not provided in content.
legal_provisions_cited: Swiss Ribbons v. Union of India, (2019) 4 SCC 17
